_comment: Revenue Optimization Plan — deterministic friction model + intervention options. Financial inputs are fictional case-study assumptions. All calculations happen in services/optimization.py.
disclaimer: Financial impact is illustrative and based on fictional case-study assumptions. Production estimates would be calibrated against Toast historical deal, implementation, and revenue data.

drivers.explanation: Age-verification requirements are frequently discovered after handoff, creating clarification and configuration work that can delay merchant go-live.

options.name: Strengthen the Discovery Playbook
options.proposed_solution: Make age verification a critical governed requirement for relevant Convenience + Fuel merchants and add conditional prompts based on merchant product mix.
constraints: Additional seller discovery time per meeting
Requirement logic must remain accurate across product mixes
Could create unnecessary friction for merchants without age-restricted products

options.name: Pre-Qualify Using Merchant Context
options.proposed_solution: Use CRM and merchant context before the meeting to identify merchants likely to require age-verification workflows and automatically prioritize the requirement.
constraints: Depends on CRM data quality
Requires reliable merchant classification
False positives require monitoring and tuning

options.name: Add an Onboarding Preflight Check
options.proposed_solution: Before the opportunity can enter onboarding, run a deterministic preflight check for required Convenience + Fuel implementation fields.
constraints: Intervention occurs later in the process
Could delay handoff when information is missing
Requires workflow integration with Salesforce

drivers.explanation: Scale and label integrations are grocery-specific and usually surface at hardware staging, forcing reconfiguration once the merchant has already committed to a build.

options.name: Add Scale & Label Requirements to the Grocery Playbook
options.proposed_solution: Standardize scale-vendor and label-print questions as critical requirements for grocery merchants, with vendor-specific conditional prompts.
constraints: More questions for grocers already handling a large playbook
Scale vendors vary by market and change over time
Requires a maintained vendor reference list

options.name: Flag Scale Risk Before Hardware Staging
options.proposed_solution: Use merchant size and deli/seafood volume signals from CRM to flag scale/label risk before hardware staging is scheduled.
constraints: Requires reliable deli/seafood classification data
Volume signals may not exist for new merchants
Needs monitoring to avoid over-flagging

options.name: Add a Hardware Configuration Gate
options.proposed_solution: Require confirmation of scale vendor and label workflow before the handoff can be marked complete for grocery merchants.
constraints: Adds a blocking step to handoff
Onboarding capacity needed to review exceptions
Merchants without scales must be exempted correctly

drivers.explanation: Multi-location merchants frequently present store-by-store differences discovered only during rollout, causing configuration rework across sites.

options.name: Strengthen Multi-Location Discovery
options.proposed_solution: Require a centralized-vs-decentralized configuration answer for every multi-location merchant, with per-store variance prompts.
constraints: Longer discovery for multi-location merchants
Stores vary in natural ways that are hard to enumerate
Requires clear guidance on what counts as a difference

options.name: Pre-Build Store Profiles From CRM
options.proposed_solution: Pre-populate per-store profiles (size, format, equipment) from CRM and surface expected differences before the meeting.
constraints: CRM store-level data is often incomplete
Requires mapping logic per vertical
Engineering dependency to build store profiles

options.name: Add a Rollout Configuration Checkpoint
options.proposed_solution: Insert a deterministic checkpoint before multi-site rollout begins, confirming store variance is captured and signed off.
constraints: Delays rollout start until variance is confirmed
Requires onboarding workflow integration
Merchants may not know variance until sites are walked

drivers.explanation: Fuel forecourt integration touches pump controllers and tank systems; when missed, rework is expensive and merchant escalation risk is high.

options.name: Require Forecourt Details at First Meeting
options.proposed_solution: Make fuel/forecourt system identification a critical requirement for all fuel merchants, with controller-vendor dropdowns and conditional questions.
constraints: Small pool of fuel deals limits statistical impact
Controller vendors vary and change
Merchants may not know their controller model offhand

options.name: Pre-Flag Fuel Merchants by Deal Type
options.proposed_solution: Use opportunity metadata to pre-flag fuel merchants and surface forecourt questions before the first meeting.
constraints: Deal-type classification must be reliable
Some fuel sites are not obvious from CRM data
Requires monitoring of false positives

options.name: Fuel Preflight Before Implementation
options.proposed_solution: Add a deterministic preflight gate requiring forecourt system and payment-type confirmation before implementation is scheduled for fuel merchants.
constraints: Blocks implementation when data is missing
Requires integration with implementation scheduling
Merchant escalation risk if blockers surface late

drivers.explanation: EBT acceptance drives approval lead times and configuration; missed EBT requirements delay go-live well beyond the initial handoff.

options.name: Standardize EBT Questions in Grocery Playbook
options.proposed_solution: Make EBT a critical requirement with implementation-approach conditional questions for all grocery merchants.
constraints: Adds a critical question to an already large grocery playbook
EBT rules differ by state
Not all grocers accept SNAP — logic must be conditional

options.name: Pre-Screen EBT Likelihood From Merchant Type
options.proposed_solution: Use merchant category and SNAP-eligibility signals to pre-screen EBT likelihood and prioritize the question.
constraints: SNAP eligibility data may be incomplete in CRM
Merchant category changes over time
Requires a maintained eligibility reference

options.name: Start EBT Approval Early
options.proposed_solution: Trigger EBT approval workflow as soon as EBT is confirmed, decoupling approval lead time from the rest of implementation.
constraints: Requires a live EBT approval integration
Approval dependencies outside Toast control
Workflow change for implementation teams

drivers.explanation: Hardware sizing gaps surface at staging, adding procurement and shipping delays that push back go-live.

options.name: Add a Hardware Needs Questionnaire
options.proposed_solution: Add a structured hardware-mix question (terminals, handhelds, scanners, cash drawers) to the general retail playbook.
constraints: Adds a question to every retail merchant meeting
Hardware needs evolve with store size
Requires reference pricing for accurate sizing

options.name: Model Hardware From Store Size
options.proposed_solution: Estimate hardware requirements from store size and format data, pre-populating the hardware question before the meeting.
constraints: Store size data is inconsistent in CRM
Estimates need rep confirmation to avoid errors
Requires a sizing model per format

options.name: Hardware Checkpoint Before Procurement
options.proposed_solution: Add a deterministic checkpoint before hardware procurement confirming count and model for each location.
constraints: Adds a step before procurement
Requires procurement workflow integration
Urgent merchants may feel the delay

drivers.explanation: Unconfirmed location counts cause multi-site rollouts to be scoped incorrectly, adding rework and re-quoting.

options.name: Require Confirmed Location Count
options.proposed_solution: Make location count a gating critical requirement with a numeric confirmation in the playbook.
constraints: Reps already ask this — change is process discipline
Merchants opening new sites may not have final counts
Requires re-quoting process alignment

options.name: Sync Location Count From CRM
options.proposed_solution: Pre-populate location count from CRM account structure and flag mismatches for rep confirmation.
constraints: CRM account hierarchies are often inaccurate
Mismatch flags need triage workflow
Requires data engineering for sync

options.name: Scope Confirmation Gate Before Quote
options.proposed_solution: Block quoting until location count is confirmed, with an exception path for pending new sites.
constraints: Can slow down merchants with aggressive timelines
Requires quoting workflow change
Exception handling adds operational load

drivers.explanation: Unconfirmed decision makers stall deals in handoff and create re-engagement loops that consume rep and onboarding time.

options.name: Add Decision-Maker Confirmation Prompt
options.proposed_solution: Add an explicit decision-maker confirmation step to the playbook, requiring name and role before discovery completes.
constraints: Reps may resist an additional required field
Multiple stakeholders can make the answer ambiguous
Requires clear definition of who counts as decision maker

options.name: Flag Stakeholder Gaps From CRM Contacts
options.proposed_solution: Use CRM contact roles to flag deals missing an economic buyer and prompt the rep before the meeting.
constraints: Contact-role data quality varies
May flag deals that are actually fine
Requires a role-mapping model

options.name: Block Handoff Without Decision Maker
options.proposed_solution: Prevent handoff generation for deals without a confirmed decision maker, routing to the rep for follow-up.
constraints: Blocks otherwise-ready handoffs
Onboarding capacity needed for exception review
Rep re-engagement loop may frustrate sellers

drivers.explanation: Required integrations (accounting, inventory, ecommerce) are often captured late, adding scoping and engineering work after handoff.

options.name: Add an Integration Checklist
options.proposed_solution: Add a structured integration requirements checklist to the playbook, with per-integration conditional questions.
constraints: Integration landscape changes frequently
Longer discovery for integration-heavy merchants
Requires a maintained integration catalog

options.name: Predict Integrations From Merchant Stack
options.proposed_solution: Use merchant back-office stack signals in CRM to predict likely integrations and pre-populate the checklist.
constraints: Back-office stack data is sparse in CRM
Requires integration catalog maintenance
Engineering dependency for prediction signals

options.name: Integration Scoping Gate Before Build
options.proposed_solution: Require confirmed integration list before implementation scoping begins, with engineering review for non-standard integrations.
constraints: Adds a step before implementation scoping
Requires engineering availability for review
Non-standard integrations are inherently slow to scope

drivers.explanation: Ambiguous timelines cause capacity planning errors and missed go-live commitments, creating rework in onboarding scheduling.

options.name: Require a Target Timeline
options.proposed_solution: Make target timeline a required field with standard options, captured at the end of every discovery meeting.
constraints: Merchants often cannot commit to a timeline
Flexible deals would need a default value
Requires capacity-planning alignment

options.name: Predict Capacity Pressure From Pipeline
options.proposed_solution: Model onboarding capacity pressure from committed timelines and flag overloaded periods to leadership.
constraints: Requires reliable timeline data across deals
Capacity model needs calibration
Engineering dependency for pipeline data

options.name: Timeline Commitment Review Before Onboarding
options.proposed_solution: Require a timeline commitment review before onboarding capacity is reserved, preventing over-commitment.
constraints: Adds a review step before onboarding
Needs onboarding team participation
May delay aggressive commitments
